Subject: Telemetry entropy & traffic reconciliation for tomorrow's traffic-shift

Hi team / Priya,

Quick note ahead of tomorrow's traffic-shift window (10/22 09:00-11:00 PT). We need a final confirmation on two things before we cut traffic from Acme's legacy gateway to the Redwood Private VPC:

1) Telemetry entropy: make sure our sampling/gating rules on the span and event ingestion don't drop the first 5 minutes of traces. We saw a small sampling bump in staging last night.
2) Traffic reconciliation hooks: the plan calls for a 5-minute drain + 2-minute validation loop, then a gradual 50/50 ramp for 10 minutes. We must capture per-route 95th latency and error-rate before and after each step.

I've attached the runbook draft (redwood_runbook_traffic_shift_v1.2.pdf) and a short checklist. Marcus — can you confirm the observability thresholds (alert burn-in & trace sampling override)? Laura — can you confirm the smoke scripts are pinned and accessible to Acme ops? Priya — does the window still look good on your end?

Next steps:
- We run a pre-shift priming (kv-cache warmup) at 08:30 PT.
- Karthik to toggle routing to canary at 09:05 PT if initial metrics look good.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior PM, Deployments
Redwood Inference

Folks — post-shift readout below (short):

Summary: traffic shift completed at 09:18 PT. Canary -> full ramp executed as planned. No rollback needed.

Key validation:
- KV cache warmup: ran smoke prime at 08:30 for 12 minutes. Cache hit-rate on primary route reached 93% before canary flip.
- Telemetry sampling: the staging bump was ingestion-backpressure from an upstream spike (queue burst). We temporarily increased the ingress buffer and bumped sampling to 100% for the first 10 minutes; we saw no loss of traces.
- Observability: 95th latency increased 18% at step 2 of the ramp and normalized within 5 minutes. Error-rate stayed < 0.6% at all times.
- Attachments: smoke_results_20261022.txt (sanity logs), netdiag_snapshot_20261022.tar.gz (nettrace snapshot).

Open items / follow-up:
- Laura/Naomi: let's update the sampling policy to have a brief automatic override during production ramps so we don't have to manually toggle. Ticket created: JIRA:NET-8427.
- Acme: please confirm your observations; if you want a post-mortem we can schedule one next week.

Thanks everyone for the smooth execution.

Marcus Lin
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
